review_loop_stopped.note: Mandatory when the review loop ends with unresolved actionable findings.

handoff.note: Mandatory when a lane transition occurs.

tool_use.note: Best-effort. Valuable but the harness does not always surface tool names.

feedback.note: Best-effort. Only emitted when a specialist raises an issue.

tool_missed.note: Conditional. Emitted only when the specialist explicitly identifies a missed tool in self_diagnosis.issues under --self-improve. Never inferred from silence. Severity is always 'advisory'. Never blocks the run.
